package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

type InterventionRepository struct{ Pool *pgxpool.Pool }

var _ repository.InterventionStore = InterventionRepository{}

func (repository InterventionRepository) Commit(
	ctx context.Context,
	signal domain.LearningActivitySignal,
	record domain.InterventionRecord,
	decision domain.TeacherDecision,
	event domain.IntegrationEvent,
) (domain.InterventionRecord, bool, error) {
	if repository.Pool == nil {
		return domain.InterventionRecord{}, false, errors.New("intervention repository pool is required")
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NewLearningActivitySignal(signal)
	if err != nil || record.EventID != normalized.EventID || record.StudentID != normalized.StudentID ||
		record.AnalyticsSessionID != normalized.AnalyticsSessionID || record.SignalType != normalized.SignalType ||
		record.DecisionID != decision.ID || decision.StudentID != normalized.StudentID ||
		record.PersonalTeacherID != decision.PersonalTeacherID || record.Action != decision.Action ||
		decision.CausationID != normalized.EventID || decision.CorrelationID != normalized.AnalyticsSessionID ||
		!record.CreatedAt.Equal(decision.CreatedAt) ||
		(record.Action != domain.TeacherActionIntervene && record.Action != domain.TeacherActionStaySilent) ||
		(record.Action == domain.TeacherActionIntervene) != (strings.TrimSpace(record.OfferBody) != "") {
		return domain.InterventionRecord{}, false, errors.New("invalid intervention record")
	}
	tx, err := repository.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.InterventionRecord{}, false, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	existing, existingErr := scanInterventionRecord(tx.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT event_id::text, student_id, analytics_session_id::text, personal_teacher_id::text,
decision_id::text, signal_type, action, COALESCE(offer_body,''), COALESCE(dialog_id::text,''),
COALESCE(dialog_message_id::text,''), created_at, delivered_at
FROM teacher_intervention_inbox WHERE event_id=$1`, record.EventID))
	if existingErr == nil {
		if existing.StudentID != record.StudentID || existing.AnalyticsSessionID != record.AnalyticsSessionID ||
			existing.SignalType != record.SignalType {
			return domain.InterventionRecord{}, false, errors.New("conflicting intervention event replay")
		}
		return existing, false, nil
	}
	if !errors.Is(existingErr, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.InterventionRecord{}, false, existingErr
	}
	if err := insertTeacherDecisionAndOutbox(ctx, tx, decision, event); err != nil {
		return domain.InterventionRecord{}, false, err
	}
	command, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_intervention_inbox
(event_id, student_id, analytics_session_id, personal_teacher_id, decision_id, signal_type, action, offer_body, created_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,NULLIF($8,''),$9)
ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING`,
		record.EventID, record.StudentID, record.AnalyticsSessionID, record.PersonalTeacherID,
		record.DecisionID, record.SignalType, record.Action, record.OfferBody, record.CreatedAt.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return domain.InterventionRecord{}, false, err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		existing, readErr := scanInterventionRecord(tx.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT event_id::text, student_id, analytics_session_id::text, personal_teacher_id::text,
decision_id::text, signal_type, action, COALESCE(offer_body,''), COALESCE(dialog_id::text,''),
COALESCE(dialog_message_id::text,''), created_at, delivered_at
FROM teacher_intervention_inbox WHERE event_id=$1`, record.EventID))
		if readErr != nil {
			return domain.InterventionRecord{}, false, readErr
		}
		if existing.StudentID != record.StudentID || existing.AnalyticsSessionID != record.AnalyticsSessionID ||
			existing.SignalType != record.SignalType {
			return domain.InterventionRecord{}, false, errors.New("conflicting intervention event replay")
		}
		return existing, false, nil
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.InterventionRecord{}, false, err
	}
	return record, true, nil
}

func (repository InterventionRepository) HasDeliveredInSession(ctx context.Context, studentID, analyticsSessionID string) (bool, error) {
	if repository.Pool == nil {
		return false, errors.New("intervention repository pool is required")
	}
	var exists bool
	err := repository.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM teacher_intervention_inbox
WHERE student_id=$1 AND analytics_session_id=$2 AND action='intervene' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL
)`, studentID, analyticsSessionID).Scan(&exists)
	return exists, err
}

func (repository InterventionRepository) MarkDelivered(ctx context.Context, eventID, dialogID, messageID string, deliveredAt time.Time) error {
	if repository.Pool == nil {
		return errors.New("intervention repository pool is required")
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(eventID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(dialogID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(messageID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	command, err := repository.Pool.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE teacher_intervention_inbox
SET dialog_id=$2, dialog_message_id=$3, delivered_at=$4
WHERE event_id=$1 AND action='intervene' AND
      (delivered_at IS NULL OR (dialog_id=$2 AND dialog_message_id=$3))`,
		eventID, dialogID, messageID, deliveredAt.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return errors.New("intervention delivery state conflict")
	}
	return nil
}

type interventionRow interface{ Scan(...any) error }

func scanInterventionRecord(row interventionRow) (domain.InterventionRecord, error) {
	var record domain.InterventionRecord
	err := row.Scan(&record.EventID, &record.StudentID, &record.AnalyticsSessionID, &record.PersonalTeacherID,
		&record.DecisionID, &record.SignalType, &record.Action, &record.OfferBody, &record.DialogID, &record.DialogMessageID,
		&record.CreatedAt, &record.DeliveredAt)
	return record, err
}
